name: Sildenafil
description: A phosphodiesterase-5 inhibitor approved for erectile dysfunction and, as Revatio, for pulmonary arterial hypertension.

systems.note: PDE5 inhibition producing vasodilation; the labelled mechanism.
Hepatically metabolised via CYP3A4; transaminase elevation is reported.
Visual disturbance and non-arteritic anterior ischaemic optic neuropathy are labelled.

monitors.why: Hepatic metabolism with reported transaminase elevation.
